        blockmikudance - third-party software and data
================================================

The page ships these libraries:

  three.js 0.187.0  https://threejs.org/        Copyright (c) 2010-2026 three.js authors          MIT License
  fflate 0.8.3      https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate   Copyright (c) 2026 Arjun Barrett       MIT License
  ammo.js           https://github.com/kripken/ammo.js  (Bullet Physics compiled to WebAssembly)  zlib License
    Bullet Physics  https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3  Copyright (c) 2003-2014 Erwin Coumans zlib License
    packaged as ammojs-typed 1.1.0  https://github.com/giniedp/ammojs-typed
                    (type definitions and packaging) Copyright (c) 2023 Alexander Gräfenstein  MIT License

Build tools (not shipped in the page): Vite (MIT), TypeScript (Apache-2.0).

The page also contains blockmp4 (the "blockmp4" choice of the first menu: videos played on a screen
of blocks), shown in a frame of its own:

  blockmp4 1.2.0    Copyright (c) 2026 holilov   blockmp4 licence (MIT terms; Japanese text, shown in
                    full on the blockmp4 page and in src/blockmp4/licenses/blockmp4_LICENSE.txt)
                    (one small change: pack.mcmeta can carry overlays, for its Minecraft 26.2 packs;
                    see src/blockmp4/README.md)
  its block list    minecraft-data.cr (RosegoldMC)   MIT License (text on the blockmp4 page and in
                    src/blockmp4/licenses/minecraft-data.cr.txt)
  Its block colours are numbers computed by blockmp4's own tools from the Minecraft client jar
  (src/blockmp4/data-*.json); no textures are included.

Everything else (PMX/PMD/VMD readers, posing, IK, skinning, physics set-up, image decoders, voxels,
NBT, ZIP/GZIP containers, datapack writer) is original code of this project, MIT License.

Block colours
-------------
src/data/blocks-26.2.json holds only numbers: the average colour of each block texture,
computed by scripts/extract-blocks.ts from the Minecraft 26.2 client jar on the developer's
own computer. No textures or other files from Minecraft are included. When you pick your own
client jar on the page, its textures are read inside your browser only, for the preview.
Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB; this project is not affiliated with Mojang
or Microsoft.
